scientific_findings: The reported non-UV canonical-Luria-Delbruck fit sets an absolute conversion applied in the UV comparison; the report properly requires calibration-transfer evidence instead of admitting native supply.
The author-reported independent pre/post-UV colony-count agreement is retained fairly, with supporting details explicitly unacquired.
Known-abundance spike-ins are correctly described as a future suggestion, not an implemented standard.
The authors explicitly leave general mechanism identifiability open; no new impossibility theorem or unique mechanistic conclusion is claimed.

Joint estimation within genuinely separate calibration data remains potentially assessable with an identifiable model, joint uncertainty, a justified count law, native context transport and pre-evaluation freeze. The report does not reject all fitting or allege circular analysis.

Barcode/group/read totals are not admitted as independent biological runs or mutation births. Pooled dependence, grouping, inherited variants, invisible loss and separate establishment/recovery remain unresolved.
The calibration-path table leaves every route unadmitted; the report preserves the yeast-to-SBW25 boundary and distinguishes source clarification from native biological validation.
